diffs.diff: voltage (V, VREF=5V): datasheet reading gives 0.0048828125 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Datasheet DS21295D Section 4.2 'Reference Input': 'the reference input (VREF) determines the analog input voltage range'; Equation 4-1 'LSB Size = VREF / 1024'; Equation 4-2 'Digital Output Code = 1024 x VIN / VREF'. Volts per count is VREF/1024, so the second reading's 0.0048828125 is just 5/1024 for an assumed VREF of 5 V. The model ties VREF to 3.3 V for ESP32/Pico use and applies the same equation: sim.spiReplies use scale 3.3/1024 = 0.00322265625 V per count on all four channels, and the driver computes raw * vref / 1024 (vref configurable). Both readings agree on the equation; only the VREF assumption differs. The gate shows 'none' because this SPI model stores its scale in sim.spiReplies, not a conversion field.
